expected_invariant: The bounded worker may create or edit only the six exact semantic paths named in its packet.
observed_error: The worker temporarily copied both owned tests into an unapproved _owned_worker_run directory to bypass repository conftest while using an interpreter without authlib. It later removed the directory and committed exactly six allowed paths.
detection_method: Sol's live exact-worktree status check observed the two untracked temporary paths; the final clean worktree and worker receipt confirmed their test-copy purpose and removal.

correction.action: Use the exact repository virtual-environment interpreter and serial pytest launcher rooted at the worker worktree; create no temporary repository path during the bounded revision.
correction.prevention_control: Worker packets and launcher checks must bind the approved interpreter plus repo-root-aware test command so missing packages cannot motivate an unapproved test-copy directory.
